nodes.name: Set Config Fields
nodes.notes: Single source of truth for everything the digest needs to run. Edit values here, nowhere else.

nodes.name: Fetch Jira Recent Activity
nodes.notes: JQL: project = {jiraProjectKey} AND updated >= -1d ORDER BY updated DESC

options.jql: =project = {{ $json.jiraProjectKey }} AND updated >= -1d ORDER BY updated DESC

nodes.name: Fetch Jira Stale Tasks
nodes.notes: JQL: project = {jiraProjectKey} AND status = "In Progress" AND updated <= -{staleTicketDays}d ORDER BY updated ASC

options.jql: =project = {{ $json.jiraProjectKey }} AND status = "In Progress" AND updated <= -{{ $json.staleTicketDays }}d ORDER BY updated ASC

nodes.name: Split Repository List
nodes.notes: Fans out Config.repos into one item per repo so the GitHub HTTP Request nodes run once per repo automatically.

nodes.name: Fetch Stale GitHub PRs
nodes.notes: GET /search/issues?q=repo:{owner}/{name}+is:pr+is:open+review:none — the review:none qualifier is the cheap way to find PRs nobody has reviewed, no per-PR calls needed.

nodes.name: Fetch GitHub PR Activity
nodes.notes: Native GitHub node — repository.getPullRequests (state=all). Classify opened/merged/closed in the next Code node.

nodes.name: Summarize Digest with OpenAI
nodes.notes: Native OpenAI Chat Complete — system + user prompts from Build LLM Prompt.

messages.content:
You are an engineering-ops assistant. You will be given JSON describing the last 24 hours of Jira and GitHub activity for a software team. Produce a concise daily digest as STRICT JSON only, no markdown, no code fences, matching exactly this shape:
{
  "whatMoved": "string, 2-4 sentences",
  "whatShipped": "string, 2-4 sentences",
  "whatIsBlocked": "string, 2-4 sentences, mention specific ticket keys",
  "needsReview": "string, 2-4 sentences, mention specific PR numbers/titles",
  "sprintHealth": "one sentence overall read, e.g. On track / At risk / Needs attention, with a short reason"
}
Only use the data given. If a category is empty, say so briefly. Do not invent tickets or PRs.

={{ JSON.stringify({ staleTicketThresholdDays: $('Set Config Fields').item.json.staleTicketDays, staleReviewThresholdHours: $('Set Config Fields').item.json.staleReviewHours, recentIssues: $json.recentIssues, staleIssues: $json.staleIssues, prsOpened: $json.prsOpened, prsMerged: $json.prsMerged, prsClosed: $json.prsClosed, prsAwaitingReview: $json.prsAwaitingReview }) }}

nodes.name: Post Digest to Slack
nodes.notes: Posts Block Kit JSON built upstream (messageType=block).
